intro_say: Trump's day, in five quotes. Let's go!
outro_say: Love it or hate it, every speech and post from today is linked in the caption. Follow for tomorrow's five!

quotes.quote: I thought this was gonna be my last one, Byron. I thought this was it. I thought I could relax. 28 days in a row of this crap is a lot.
quotes.quote_say: I thought this was gonna be my last one, Byron. I thought this was it. I thought I could relax. Twenty-eight days in a row of this crap is a lot.
quotes.intro_say: On the final stretch of the campaign, speaking to Byron Donalds.

quotes.quote: Fox is giving Democrats more time than they give Republicans.
David Jolly, a real loser. But a terrible person. Everybody hated the guy.
quotes.intro_say: On David Jolly, the Democrat running for Florida governor.

quotes.quote: I had like close to 50,000. He had 900. They don't want to mention my crowd size.
quotes.quote_say: I had like close to fifty thousand. He had nine hundred. They don't want to mention my crowd size.
quotes.intro_say: On his crowds versus Bernie Sanders.
